citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:24 AM on 31-
August-2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by speaking to a household member who was present at
the facility and calling the licensee and leaving a voicemail. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records
for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in
enforcement action.
End Section
